text.p: -Caspian Securities said it downgraded Transportacion Maritima Mexicana (TMM) on Monday to market performer from a buy recommendation.
-Senior analyst Phokion Potamianos said the recent $1.4 billion concession by a TMM-led partnership will dilute its earnings in the short term.

-Although TMM has not yet provided financing details, Potamianos said the company will probably not earn enough in initial years from the railroad's operations to support anticipated growth for Mexico's leading marine shipping company.

-"We think the return on equity on the project in the next two to four years will be lower than the company average. Despite the lack of information on financing, nevertheless it is likely to dilute earnings," Potamianos said.

-TMM and Kansas City Southern Industries Inc jointly submitted the winning bid last week in the privatization of Mexico's key north-south railroad. The companies have not given financing details, saying only that it is likely to be off the companies' books.
-TMM American Depositary Receipts traded AT midday at 7, down from an opening 7-1/8.
